title: New Weekly Loyalty Streak Rewards
author: Architect of Chaos
summary: Keep Control & Chaos in your public Second Life profile picks to earn compounding weekly streak bonuses at the Main Terminal.
content:
### Compounding Loyalty Rewards for Active Community Members

We have updated the Control & Chaos Main Terminal's Profile Pick Verification engine. Starting this week, players who keep `[Control & Chaos]` in their Second Life public profile picks can claim escalating weekly rewards.

### How to Claim

1. Add **Control & Chaos** with our region SLurl into one of your profile picks.
2. Touch the **Loyalty Kiosk** located at the Main Sim Terminal.
3. Verify every 7 days to maintain your active streak.

Streaks beyond 4 consecutive weeks unlock rare gold titler titles and exclusive venue VIP pass permissions!
